description: Convert a WMV or ASF video (WMV1/2/3, VC-1, WMA; base64, max 15 MB) into a universal H.264/AAC MP4 with +faststart for Mac, iPhone, Android and web playback. Uses instant lossless remux when already H.264, otherwise transcodes with configurable CRF quality (19/23/28), optional resolution downscale (1080p/720p/480p), AAC audio or mute, yadif deinterlacing and metadata stripping. Deterministic local ffmpeg, 0 AI, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.004/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/wmv-to-mp4.

audio.description: AAC audio bitrate (160/128 kbps) or mute

deinterlace.description: Apply yadif deinterlacing for interlaced camcorder/VHS WMV files

fileContent.description: Base64-encoded .wmv or .asf video (max 15 MB; empty = built-in sample WMV2/WMAV2 video)
